 Job summary : The BI Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Business Intelligence solutions that support reporting, analytics, and decision‑making processes across the organization. The role works closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and functional teams to deliver accurate, scalable, and user‑friendly BI reports and dashboards.
 This position is suited for candidates with strong SQL skills, experience with BI tools (Qlik and Power BI), and a solid understanding of data modeling and data quality standards.
 Reports to : Head of SW Development
 Key Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and maintain BI solutions including dashboards, reports, and self‑service analytics tools
Translate business requirements into technical BI specifications
Develop optimized SQL queries and data models to support reporting and analytics
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across BI deliverables
Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Partner with oracle developers to integrate data from multiple sources (ERP, CRM, HR, finance systems etc.);
Configure, implement, and maintain BI application servers
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and priorities
Promote BI best practices and data literacy within the organization
Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and access standards
Continuously optimize BI performance and usability
Document BI solutions, data models, and business logic
 Key Requirements: 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field;
3+ years of experience as a BI Developer, Data Analyst, or similar role
Hands‑on experience delivering dashboards and reports for business users
Strong SQL skills (complex queries, performance tuning)
Experience with BI tools such as: QlikView , Power BI, Tableau, Looker
Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL)
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling
Strong knowledge of ETL processes and data pipelines.
